title: celery chord task raise critical error while redis backend connection socket timeout
body:
Hi all, we found when the server read from redis backend socket timeout, part of the chord body would lost. Can anyone give some help? Following is the traceback:

```
807_Mainthread /opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/celery/app/trace.py:365: RuntimeWarning: Exception raised outside body: TimeoutError('Timeout reading from socket',
Traceback (most recent call last):

    on_chord_part_return(task, state, R)
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/celery/backends/base.py", line 555, in on_chord_part_return
    val = self.incr(key)
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/celery/backends/redis.py", line 175, in incr
    return self.client.incr(key)
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/redis/client.py", line 842, in incr
    return self.execute_command('INCRBY', name, amount)
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/redis/client.py", line 529, in execute_command
    return self.parse_response(connection, command_name, **options)
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/redis/client.py", line 541, in parse_response
    response = connection.read_response()
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/redis/connection.py", line 572, in read_response
    response = self._parser.read_response()
  File "/opt/tiger/ss_lib/python_package/lib/python2.7/site-packages/redis/connection.py", line 321, in read_response
    raise TimeoutError("Timeout reading from socket")
TimeoutError: Timeout reading from socket
```
